TEXT:
It's been a few years since then. Don't be surprised, 
but we started up our own company.

Sena and I got all the members of the game 
research club together.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Man... I never thought you guys would get into your 
game creation hobby enough to make it a job.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
I never thought it would happen either. I certainly 
thought the president wouldn't, for sure.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: ...What's that supposed to mean, Makabe.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
I mean, I didn't think a man infamous for his shitty 
games can actually end up in a game company.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
You...! You're just gonna say it upfront instead of 
hinting at it!? Your remarks have been getting 
worse ever since you stepped into the workforce!

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
And I'm not the club president anymore. I'm the 
company president! I'm the one who's keeping the 
lights on, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
I can't help it. You'll always be the club president to 
me.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Then, at least refer to me using something normal, 
like Miura-san or the like.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
Well, I'd like to, but if I called you by your name, a 
certain someone might get a little too excited...

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: Ah... right, I forgot about that...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
...Ufufufu, it's great that they ended up in the same 
company...① I can actually watch the President and 
Makabe exchange their love while making my games...①

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Sena-chan, you're drooling all over!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Good grief, do you plan on having your guardian 
around while working? Your brother complex is 
quite bothersome.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Wrong! Nope! Onii-chan is here not for me, but for 
Kousaka-senpai!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Why is he here for me?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Well Senpai, won't work become easier with your 
boyfriend close by?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: If he's this close, I won't be able to do any work.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
What are you saying, Kousaka? Don't just flat out 
reject the settings Sena's made in her mind of us 
being lovers.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You need to think clearly for once! Are you saying 
you would be my lover, just for Sena?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Let me think about being a top or bottom for a bit.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You don't need to do that!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Ah, but... Onii-chan is in the trading business, so you 
won't be able to be together.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
If so, seeing him get close to other men to meet his 
quota... Kousaka-senpai might one day explode from 
sexual desire and jealousy...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Shut up. I'll rub your breasts.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
No! You're a productive member of society but still 
a sexual harassment senpai? Kya!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...You two... I'll verify once more, but you're dating 
each other, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Yes!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Even so, you continue to pair men in your mind...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Yeah. I thought when I started going out with her 
that she would stop doing that, but... on the 
contrary, it's been getting worse lately...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
But with this setting, Onii-chan is jealous of his sister. 
And Kousaka-senpai is really bi and the President 
with Makabe is added. Then the delusion grows!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
Stop,  I don't want to be dragged into this 
Sargasso Sea!!

Makabe, who still isn't used to Sena's delusions, has 
gotten teary-eyed.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
But, those delusions were the base of the BL game. 
The reception was good enough to make this 
company, so... my delusions are great, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
In other words, it has become this generation's 
"alchemy"... The Mystic Eyes should be feared...

Yes, the reason we were able to establish this 
company was thanks to Sena's BL game.

We used the RPG "Brotherhood" we made for the 
cultural festival as a base, enhanced the BL portions 
and improved the gameplay...

As we made a few spin-offs, we announced them at 
Comiket.

It was a big hit for a doujin game, so we took the 
chance and made a game company.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Well, thanks to my many delusions, everyone 
managed to find employment, so you should thank 
this fujoshi, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Don't stick your chest out in pride. I'll rub them 
then.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Onii-chan, Kousaka-senpai is being mean.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
Hey Kousaka... shall we continue our fight to the 
death on the Ferris Wheel...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Whoa, hey. Don't just pull your brother in to protect 
you!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...I knew she had a brother complex.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
No, you're wrong! I was going to gather some 
research by watching them fight!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Sometimes, I take these scenes and conversations 
and throw them into BL games.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-You... really mean that...

I was too shocked to react and was further 
showered by an explosive announcement.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Yes, I've already done this about ten times. You 
didn't notice?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
No... I didn't... What have I been selling this whole 
time...

And it was with Akagi. No wonder we are always 
tasked to do promotional events together!

Crap, the fans have always been going, "Those two 
really are close..." Now I know why!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...I feel that being a woman is the greatest form of 
happiness when it comes to working in this 
company...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ? Why?

I don't blame Kuroneko for sighing. Sena puts all of 
the guys around her in her delusions and couples 
them.

But this power has also been the driving force for 
several products...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Well, good for you, finding a job where you can 
make money doing what you love.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...Yeah, and it's thanks to you, Senpai.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What, I had nothing to do with it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
You always say that. But, the most important part 
was that you were with me. You've been a great 
help.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-Is that so?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Yes. You're a great unrequited love bottom! When 
I'm with you, I feel like I can keep making more 
and more BL material, I can't stop!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W-What the heck, so that's why?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Of course... there are many other important reasons 
though.

Sena then placed her head against my chest. When 
I rubbed her head, she looked up and smiled.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...Even though your relationship is made public, 
could you not blatantly flirt in public? You'll ruin the 
morals of our company.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Huh? I never expected to be lectured about 
morals by Gokou-san!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Yeah, you complained about others being loud in 
the past, but now you're the one being loud.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: But I can't help it. I love Senpai so much, right①

Sena, acting all spoiled, puts her head against my 
chest.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: H-Hey... cut it out. that's embarrassing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
*sigh*... It's clear as day. The main reason we were 
all gathered for this company was that you didn't 
want to be apart from your lover.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Ehehehe, as a matter of fact, yep.

As Sena puts her head on my chest again, 
Kuroneko makes a big sigh again.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
With that honest answer, you stopped having 
self-control in a different meaning than before.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
That's all thanks to Senpai. I feel if you have 
someone who accepts you, you stop having to hide 
things about yourself.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...Good for you. Well, there are also people who can't 
stomach that stuff either, though.

Kuroneko looked over and there was Akagi, 
breathing heavily through his nose.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
...I... lost once, and left you with Sena! I'm not going 
to criticize you!

Like a man, Akagi gave his declaration. He was 
clenching his fists really hard though. You're gonna 
pop a blood vessel like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
Kousaka... If you do anything to make Sena cry, I 
will neeeeeever forgive you!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah yeah, I know. There's no way I'd let her cry.
I gently held the small back in front of me.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: S-Senpai...

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
...*sigh* Should I use my position to ban inter-office 
relationships? It's so lovey-dovey, it hurts my eyes.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Eh? If that happens, you and Makabe will have a 
crack surface in your relationship though?

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: No, it won't!
Seriously... she's always like this.
I whispered into Sena's ear.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
...Hey, don't go overboard with those delusions of 
other guys. If you're gonna have a delusion, make it 
only me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Because I'll always be with you.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...Okay.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: I'll always be with you too... Senpai.
This, in a way isn't a bad relationship.

Having my lover look at me, continuing to moe for 
me.
